# User account settings You can find general account settings and Service Account settings by clicking on your user initials on the right-hand side of the Navigation Bar. On the `Account` page, you can: * Change your password * Set up two-factor authentication * Find privacy settings * Find viewer settings * Manage notification settings * Manage API tokens * Create and manage webhooks Here is an example of the `Account` page that shows the settings you can modify (select the images to expand them):
## Notification settings You receive notifications through the **Bell icon** in the top navigation bar and/or by email for a number of different events, such as when a new model has been published in a group you are a member of. Click on the bell symbol on the navigation bar to access your notifications. A red number next to the bell tells you how many unread notifications you have. Click a notification to open the affected model or activity. In the Account Settings, you can enable notifications via the Bell icon and/or email for the following events: **General users** * Group invitation received * Model is published to group * Model is forked * Pull request received * Parent model is updated * Model imports have updates **Activities** * New task received * Task has activity * Task is published to group * Model is shared with you * Task is shared with you * An activity you’re contributing to has been merged **Approvals** * Status of approval to share model to group has changed * You have been assigned to review a new activity * Your review in an activity has been overridden by a new revision * Approval or rejection for an activity has been revoked * Activity has been closed or reopened * An activity has been approved * Changes have been requested on an activity you’re assigned to * Automerge has failed * Automerge has been skipped {% hint style="success" %} There are additional notifications available for administrators of a Solidatus environment. {% endhint %}
